-- pgai-window-v1 ${__from} ${__to} ${__interval_ms} range
WITH q AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT labels, t, value
FROM prom_irate(('pgwatch_pg_stat_slru_blks_hit'),
       [['cluster','=',(${cluster_name:sqlstring})],['node_name','=',(${node_name:sqlstring})],['datname','=~',('${db_name:regex}')]],
       ($__pgai_start_ms), ($__pgai_end_ms), ($__pgai_step_ms), ($__pgai_rate_interval_ms))
), names AS (SELECT DISTINCT q."labels" FROM q), legend_names AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT row(q."labels") AS __key, coalesce(q.labels['name'], '') AS __series, CASE WHEN cardinality(q.labels) = 1 THEN map_values(q.labels)[1] ELSE '{' || array_to_string(list_transform(list_sort(map_keys(q.labels)), lambda k: k || '="' || q.labels[k] || '"'), ', ') || '}' END AS label_set FROM names q
), ranked AS (
SELECT *, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(label_set, '')) AS __rank FROM legend_names
), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT __key, __series, lpad(CAST(__rank AS VARCHAR), CAST(length(CAST(max(__rank) OVER () AS VARCHAR)) AS INTEGER), '0') AS __sid FROM ranked
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, n.__series, n.__sid
FROM q JOIN rendered n ON row(q."labels") IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.__key
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time
